newsitem.title: FRANCE: London airports top EU January air cargo traffic.
newsitem.headline: London airports top EU January air cargo traffic.

text.p: The three main London airports recorded the highest percentage gain in cargo traffic in January 1997 among the EU's top cargo-handling airports, according to figures issued by the Aeroports de Paris (ADP).
Cargo throughput at the three London airports (Heathrow, Gatwick and Stansted), in the month in question totalled 110,153 tonnes, a rise of 7.3 percent on January 1996.

Cargo volume handled at Frankfurt airport in the first month of the current year was up 5.4 percent on 1996 levels at 98,272 tonnes while 86,438 tonnes of freight was handled at Amsterdam's Schiphol airport, an increase of 4.7 percent.
January 1997 cargo traffic handled at the Paris airports increased by 1.3 percent on 1996 levels reaching 81,927 tonnes. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017
